description: Manually judged search evaluation queries for HireProof AI. Relevance: 2 = directly answers the query, 1 = partially relevant. Judged against the synthetic demo dataset in lib/demo-data.js.

backend engineer with Node.js and PostgreSQL performance experience
python data engineer with Airflow and SQL pipelines
